facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mary heard crying at night. She found a boy named Colin. He stayed in bed all day. Colin was afraid.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: One night Mary followed the sound of someone crying loudly. She found a pale boy lying alone in a dark, cold room. His name was Colin and he was her uncle's only son. Colin was afraid of going outside and believed he was dying. He had stayed in his bed for years without seeing the sun. Everyone in the house treated him like he was made of glass.
